clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Hillsbrad, Darrow Hill's rugged grassland rises beneath the Headland. Mountain lions and stags roam its open slopes, while feral yetis lurk in the Foothill Caverns. Alterac Granite draws travelers into this dangerous frontier.

Darrow Hill stretches below the Headland, joining southern Hillsbrad's rolling pasture to Alterac's jagged, colder heights. Mountain lions and stags move through tall grasses on its rocky slopes, and towering yetis emerge from the Foothill Caverns. The cavern walls hold deposits of dense Alterac Granite, drawing quarry workers, miners, and adventurers into danger. Regional claims remain contentious, and travelers of either faction can be caught unaware on the trails.
